flashcard_questions.q: What did Hitler invade in March 1939, tearing up the Munich Agreement?
Which country did Britain and France guarantee after Czechoslovakia fell?
On what date was the Nazi-Soviet Pact signed?
What is the other name for the Nazi-Soviet Pact?
Who signed the Pact for the Soviet Union in Moscow?
What did the Pact’s secret protocol agree about Poland?
flashcard_questions.a: Germany and the USSR would divide it between them.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Baltic state was added to Stalin’s sphere of influence a month later?
Which nightmare from World War One did the Pact let Germany avoid?
How much food, oil and raw material did the USSR promise Germany?
How many of the Red Army’s 103 generals had Stalin’s purges executed?
Why did the weakened Red Army push Stalin towards signing?
flashcard_questions.a: The Pact bought him time to rearm.

flashcard_questions.q: Where did Stalin move Soviet factories after signing the Pact?
flashcard_questions.a: Behind the Ural Mountains, deeper into Russia.

flashcard_questions.q: How many new warplanes did Germany send Stalin in return?
On what date did Germany invade Poland?
Why did Stalin distrust Britain’s approach in 1939?
flashcard_questions.a: Britain sent Drax by slow boat with no power to agree anything.

notes: 15 cards: 4 event/date, 4 figure, 3 person/term, 4 cause-effect. Split the secret protocol into separate Poland and Lithuania cards rather than listing the Baltic states.
